recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill render CLI commands with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: kspec skill render shows summary of created/updated/skipped files (existing)
- ac-2: kspec skill render @task-work renders only that skill (added positional ref support)
- ac-3: kspec skill status shows table with sync status (in-sync, drifted, not-rendered)
- ac-4: kspec skill diff @task-work shows unified diff when content differs

Added 11 new tests covering all ACs. Updated existing render command to support positional ref argument for single-skill rendering per spec.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill rendering pipeline with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: kspec skill render creates .claude/skills/<id>/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter
- ac-2: docs copied from .kspec/skills/<id>/docs/ to .claude/skills/<id>/docs/
- ac-3: Idempotent rendering - no changes if content unchanged
- ac-4: --clean only considers kspec-managed skills (identified by marker)
- ac-5: --clean removes orphaned managed skill directories

Additional features:
- --dry-run support (from @trait-dry-run)
- --skill <id> to render specific skill
- Platform filtering (only claude-code skills rendered)
- Handles missing source SKILL.md with placeholder
- Strips existing frontmatter and replaces with generated

Added 21 tests covering all acceptance criteria and edge cases.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill meta integration with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: kspec meta get @skill-id returns skill metadata (by id or ULID prefix)
- ac-2: kspec meta list --type skill shows only skills
- ac-3: kspec meta show includes skill count in summary
- ac-4: resolveMetaRefToUlid includes skills in resolution

Changes:
- Updated resolveMetaRefToUlid() to check skills array (by id or ULID prefix)
- Updated meta get command to find skills
- Updated meta list command to filter/include skills
- Updated formatMetaShow() to display skill count

Added 12 tests covering all acceptance criteria in skill-meta-integration.test.ts

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill import command with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: YAML frontmatter parsing for name/description extraction
- ac-2: Content copied to .kspec/skills/<id>/SKILL.md
- ac-3: docs/ subdirectory copied recursively if present
- ac-4: --origin option sets origin field (default: project)
- ac-5: --id option allows custom ID (default: directory name)
- ac-6: Error with guidance when no frontmatter and no --name/--description
- ac-7: Base-directory lines stripped from imported content

Helper functions:
- parseFrontmatter(): extracts name/description from YAML frontmatter
- normalizeBaseDirectory(): strips absolute path lines
- copyDirectory(): recursive directory copy

Added 17 tests covering all 7 acceptance criteria in skill import section.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill set command with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: --description option updates description field in meta
- ac-2: --add-platform adds platform to platforms array (no duplicates)
- ac-3: --add-tag adds tag to tags array (no duplicates)

Additional features beyond AC requirements:
- --name, --origin, --skill-version for updating other fields
- --remove-platform, --remove-tag for removing items from arrays
- --add-depends-on, --remove-depends-on for managing dependencies
- Schema validation on save
- ULID prefix lookup support

Added 19 tests specific to skill set command covering all ACs.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
